ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (approximately 80%) with high-contrast black pixels (approximately 20%) localized at the base, trailing edges, and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation at the peduncle base. Distinct circular black focal spot in the lower central region. Symmetrical black banding along the trailing edge serrations. Dense black pigmentation cluster on the outer margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a deep vertex; approximately 45-degree angle of convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks varying between 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in a sharp, slightly upturned taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters scattered across the white ventral expanse, notably in the mid-right lobe and surrounding the central focal spot.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear marks visible on the right lobe surface, cutting across the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/depression on the outer distal edge of the left lobe tip. Heavy dark scarring or pigment cluster at the peduncle insertion point partially occluded by water splash.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, isolated circular dark spot located in the mid-lower central ventral field.
